basis: OS-ALPHA-001. Source-only: pinned device/google/cuttlefish 283645aa and build/make b0f697df were read and the product chain evaluated on fixtures (os/tests/test_cuttlefish_alpha_product.py); no Android build, image or boot is claimed.

base.requires: An already independent source root holding the 2804 integration, including os/patches/updater-product-build-make.patch in build/make. Never the retained Pixel root.

changedFiles.change: Adds Seedvault and its pinned required closure (LocalContactsBackup, com.stevesoltys.backup_allowlist, com.stevesoltys.backup_default-permissions, com.stevesoltys.backup_privapp_allowlist, default-permissions_app.grapheneos.backup.contacts) to aosp_shared_system_image deps only, so file_list_diff matches the media_system.mk Seedvault. No removal, allowlist or diff change; system_image_defaults untouched.
Removes only the RoseOS 'PRODUCT_PACKAGES += Updater' block; the upstream OFFICIAL_BUILD block stays and OFFICIAL_BUILD stays unset. Seedvault stays.

inheritance.systemImage: aosp_cf.mk sets USE_SOONG_DEFINED_SYSTEM_IMAGE=true with aosp_shared_system_image (build/make target/product/generic/Android.bp), which lists no Updater; core/Makefile file_list_diff fails the build on system files installed by make but absent from that image (allowlist: init.environ.rc). Hence the Rose Updater line must not reach this target.
inheritance.seedvault: media_system.mk lists Seedvault (system priv-app, platform cert); its pinned required closure is 6 modules (Seedvault, LocalContactsBackup, three com.stevesoltys.backup_* prebuilt_etc, default-permissions_app.grapheneos.backup.contacts). None appears in any of the 69 build/make Android.bp files, so aosp_shared_system_image lacked it; the delta lists it there. A tree-wide search outside build/make was not possible (codeload archive 403, not retried); explicit deps are harmless if another path exists.
inheritance.trayProperty: aosp_shared_system_image -> system_image_defaults deps 'system-build.prop' -> build/soong build_prop product_config ':product_config' (merged soong.<DeviceProduct>.variables + extra.variables of the lunched product) -> core/soong_extra_config.mk PRODUCT_SYSTEM_PROPERTIES of that product -> gen_build_prop.py build_system_prop. The Rose line inherited from generic_system.mk is in that list; no override needed.

present: PRODUCT/app/RosePreinstall_dev_pixel_voice/RosePreinstall_dev_pixel_voice.apk byte-identical to the dev.pixel.voice sha256 above
PRODUCT/app/RosePreinstall_dev_pixel_calculator_agent/RosePreinstall_dev_pixel_calculator_agent.apk byte-identical to the dev.pixel.calculator.agent sha256 above
SYSTEM_EXT/priv-app/PixelBackgroundControl/PixelBackgroundControl.apk byte-identical to the dev.pixel.backgroundcontrol sha256 above
framework-res config Agents/Targets matching the policy above
SYSTEM/priv-app/Seedvault/Seedvault.apk and SYSTEM/app/LocalContactsBackup/LocalContactsBackup.apk with their etc XML, as in the Frankel baseline
absent: any APK whose package is app.seamlessupdate.client

knownRisks: The tray property is shown reaching the generator input and output on fixtures; the built system build.prop still needs checking in the alpha image.
Seedvault closure: no reference outside build/make was searched (403 on the archive route); an unexpected extra Seedvault path would only duplicate an explicit dep.
pixelUnchanged: apply-os-changes.py keeps applying updater-product-build-make.patch for Frankel; this patch is never applied by it and never to the retained Pixel root.
